$comment: Tracker format delivered with the tool. A repository replaces any section with the plans key in simt.json; a section it omits stays as written here. directories are the only places read, and each word is what a dependency uses to name that place ("review 0002 S41"). Headers are tried in the order written. Only a state marked satisfies unblocks a slice that depends on it. ready is the state plan next returns. dependency.group matches a wave of rows; wave names that table's columns. Tier is optional: a slice tagged with one lets plan next stay inside that class, and wave filters by the group tables, alone or with a tier. Lane is optional too: it names the subsystem a slice's files belong to, so slices in different lanes can run at once and plan next --lane hands one agent a file set no other lane owns. A column named something this file does not list is reported by plan labels as unmatched, and naming it under columns in simt.json plans makes it readable without a code change. Reviewer is optional and names who reviews the slice - a model or a person; a state carrying the review role means the work is done but not accepted, so nothing depending on it is ready yet.
name: tracker
